【原视频简介】
There are over 3 million models on Hugging Face and zero indication of whether any of them will actually run on your machine — so we tested a tool called llmfit that looks at your hardware and tells you exactly which models fit. We ran it on five wildly different machines, from a 2012 Raspberry Pi to an RTX 5090, to see how good its recommendations actually are (some of them are hilariously wrong). If you're tired of guessing which quantization to download, this might save you a lot of failed downloads.
